title: Delete Node in a BST
summary: Delete a value from a BST and restore the BST property.
description:
Delete a value from a BST and restore the BST property.

Approach: Handle 0/1/2 children; for two children, replace with inorder successor then delete that.
approach: Handle 0/1/2 children; for two children, replace with inorder successor then delete that.

tree.insert(50)
tree.insert(30)

tree.insert(20)
tree.insert(40)

tree.delete(30)
tree.traverseInorder()
